content: Common Mahjong Solitaire algorithm mistakes include: incorrect 'free tile' detection (must have no tile above and at least one side open), naive shuffle that breaks solvability, hint systems that suggest any matching pair instead of a pair that leads to a solvable state, and undo stacks that don't restore the full board state including previously exposed tiles. Blocked-tile logic must account for both horizontal neighbors and tiles above; corner cases at layout boundaries are frequent bugs.
